concepts.quote: 1 and 6, because a > b is false so nothing in the if runs.
concepts.why: The student gets 2 > 2 as false, skips the then branch and goes on to line 6, but misses that the else branch (line 4) runs when the condition is false; the correct order is 1, 4, 6.
The answer does not mention && or || evaluation, and the code has neither.
